placement.state: reuse the lifetime-exclusive runtime-batch tuple; no new ordinary Bank-0 BSS

lifetime_invariant.rule: runtime batch execution and append-transaction authentication never overlap
lifetime_invariant.construction: transaction begin rejects a live batch; batch entry rejects an active transaction; both paths release the shared discriminator
lifetime_invariant.failure: any attempted overlap is rejected before the shared tuple changes

semantic_invariants: family evidence is authenticated once per append transaction
record bounds, payload CRC and wipe remain per slice
payload mutation between transactions in one generation remains fail-closed
generation change forces fresh family authentication fail-closed
first_red_rule: Any failed host, mutation, island, BSS, E000, slice, placement or structure gate stops before a product link. Link 30 remains unchanged.
